course_name: Principles of Information Security and Cryptography

learning_outcomes.description: Explain symmetric and asymmetric encryption principles, key exchange protocols (Diffie-Hellman), and cryptographic hashing.
Identify and mitigate common application vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and SSRF.
Assess authentication security mechanisms, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and public-key infrastructure (PKI).

weeks.topic: Introduction to Security Concepts: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability (CIA Triad).
Classical Ciphers, Block Ciphers, and Data Encryption Standard (DES/AES).
Asymmetric Cryptography: Number Theory Foundations, RSA, and Elliptic Curves.
Hash Functions (SHA-256), HMAC, and Digital Signature Schemes.
Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Certificates, and TLS Handshake Architecture.
Web Application Security: OWASP Top 10, Injection Attacks, and Cross-Site Scripting.
Authentication Mechanisms: Passwords, Password Hashing (Argon2), and OAuth 2.0.
Network Security: Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and VPN Protocols.
Threat Modeling, Incident Response, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle.
